## SECTION 3: PROFESSIONAL SERVICES (SAMStack Studio)

### 3.1 — MERN Stack Web Development
Full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Specialization in B2B SaaS platforms, enterprise dashboards, admin panels, and RESTful API architectures.

### 3.2 — Next.js Web Development
High-performance, SEO-optimized web applications using Next.js App Router, Server Components, and Vercel deployment. Core competency in enterprise-scale Next.js architecture.

### 3.3 — Laravel Web Development
Secure, robust backend systems and REST APIs using Laravel (PHP). Ideal for enterprise-grade web portals, ERP integrations, and database-heavy web apps.

### 3.4 — Flutter Mobile App Development
Cross-platform iOS and Android applications built with Flutter and Dart. Integrations include Firebase, REST APIs, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Google Maps, and push notifications.

### 3.5 — Data Analysis & Business Intelligence
Business data transformation using Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL queries, and Power BI dashboards. Services include sales forecasting, supply chain optimization, and customer behavior analysis.

### 3.6 — SEO, GEO & AEO (Search Optimization)
Technical SEO, Local SEO (Lahore / Pakistan), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO for AI search), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO for featured snippets). Full schema markup (JSON-LD) implementation.

### 3.7 — Software Testing & Quality Assurance (QA)
Enterprise-grade QA services: manual testing, automated testing, regression testing, performance profiling, and bug tracking. Ensures software stability before production deployment.
